{{note|ambassador|1}} As the two ambassadors for the merge tribe, Gaëlle and Nathalie had to cast an extra vote for someone at the first post-merge Tribal Council. They chose to cast an extra vote against Estelle.<br />
{{note|final4|2}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Ludovic came in last and was eliminated.<br />
